item.title: How the Model Relay Service Becomes an Attacker
item.author: https://blog.jqknono.com (jqknono)
item.description: Use a series of diagrams to clarify the five attack surfaces of untrusted model relay (model routing) services: information theft, data hijacking, resource hijacking, content tampering, and supply chain poisoning, as well as corresponding defense measures.
